answer: A graded-work beacon posts each epoch's median jury score into a public juniper ledger that only unlocks payout when the submitting key's vine of prior epochs shows rising cost-per-pass. Sybils that farm empty seats pay full grader minutes on every fork while the ledger raises the stake threshold by the square of failed attestations; the thousandth clone burns more inventory than the first earned. Empty templates never clear the beacon, so attacker spend scales with seats opened, not keys spun.
